profile.headline: Consulting Project Manager and Engineer
profile.summary:
I am an accomplished project manager with 8+ years of project management experience and 13+ years of software engineering experience and am looking to leverage my skill set in new and challenging ways.  Here are some highlights of what I can bring to the table:
- Proven leadership and technical expertise demonstrated by consistently delivering complex engineering projects on time and at or under budget
- Creative and innovative problem-solving skills 
- A collaborative, customer-focused approach significantly increasing value realization and earning repeat and new business opportunities

positions.title: Project Manager/Software Engineer
positions.description: Independent contractor for software development and hardware/software integration and project management

positions.title: Deputy Program Manager/Lead Engineer
positions.description:
Program/project and engineering management of software simulations and training device solutions.

Responsibilities include:
- Managed program/project schedules, resources, scope, financials, risks, change control and stakeholders
- Spearheaded successful effort to enter simulation training device market
- Lead collaborative efforts with cross-functional teams of engineers, artists, subject matter experts, production teams and subcontractors
- Facilitated positive and collaborative interaction with clients to ensure complete satisfaction with products and services
- Directed the analysis, design and implementation of hardware and software solutions to meet project specifications and requirements
- Delivered all simulation devices on time and at or under total $30M budget over five year contract period prompting clients to initiate a new, similar contract for a different aircraft.
- Heavy involvement in software development

positions.title: Project Manager/Lead Engineer
positions.description: Managed project and engineering development of simulations and training device solutions including heavy involvement in software development..

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed software simulations and training device solutions.

Responsibilities included:
- Participating in and leading analysis, design, implementation, testing and debugging of software and hardware solutions to meet project requirements and training objectives
- Object Oriented Programming with heavy emphasis on C/C++, Open GL and integration of various third-party software libraries
- Moderate use of scripting languages such as Python and Bash
- Using Software Integrated Development Environments such as Visual Studio, Eclipse and NetBeans
- Creating code at production facilities and customer sites using only VI, Makefiles and GCC
- Designing Graphical User Interfaces using third-party products such as wxWidgets and QT 
- Hardware/Software Integration for communicating with and controlling IO systems and other hardware 
- Extensive cross-platform (Windows, Unix/Linux) development including installation, configuration and administration
- Extensive experience with project documentation including software design documents, technical manuals, user manuals and software and engineering design data packages
- Training and mentoring junior engineers
- Extensive client interaction and collaboration

positions.title: Software Development Consultant
positions.description: Developed software solutions for military combat theater asset command and control training.

positions.title: Lab Director
positions.description: Managed language laboratory to ensure academic needs of student and staff were met.

positions.title: Propulsion Plant Engineer (Machinist's Mate)
positions.description: Responsible for engineering plant operation and maintenance to provide power generation, propulsion and support systems for shipboard use.
